body:
Goose is now included in the actual main comparison as **PR #143 / outcome 120**: [main issue list](https://github.com/arjaythedev/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/issues/7#issuecomment-6292218419), [all-outcome CSV](https://github.com/tbsvttr/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/blob/643a55e26853341feac6fbcb168ad4c9a909ee9d/benchmarks/2026-10-22/comparison.csv), [filterable HTML](https://github.com/tbsvttr/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/blob/643a55e26853341feac6fbcb168ad4c9a909ee9d/benchmarks/2026-10-22/comparison.html), [report](https://github.com/tbsvttr/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/blob/643a55e26853341feac6fbcb168ad4c9a909ee9d/benchmarks/2026-10-22/report.md).

The matching ranking protocol (stock wrk, 3×15 seconds, one server CPU / 2 GiB / no swap) measured Goose at **117,565.71 successful req/s**, p99 **22.060 ms**, RSS **15.26 MiB**, zero HTTP errors and **38 reported wrk timeouts**. It appears in the diagnostic results with no clean rank. The fresh unchanged Rust #82 control measured 106,162.00 req/s with 34 reported wrk timeouts; its earlier ranked value remains untouched. [All six attempts and provenance](https://github.com/tbsvttr/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/blob/643a55e26853341feac6fbcb168ad4c9a909ee9d/benchmarks/goose-2026-10-22/ranking-3x15-2026-10-22/measurements.json).

**All 119 previous outcome measurements and both historical measured revisions are preserved.** The [separate corrected-driver 10×45-second confirmation](https://github.com/tbsvttr/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/blob/643a55e26853341feac6fbcb168ad4c9a909ee9d/benchmarks/goose-2026-10-22/lead5/holdout-hmac/RESULT.md) remains separate: +13.72% paired point estimate, +1.85% one-sided 95% lower bound, stable ≥5% target unmet. [Implementation PR](https://github.com/arjaythedev/twelve-dollar-server-challenge/pull/143); its Ubuntu 24.04 install/build/API CI passed.
